name: Bestias
source:
Stories are meant to scare children. But tonight, the forest is telling them to you – and you're the main character.

[From [url=https://itzapeggy.itch.io/bestias-v01]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
怪谈故事原本只是用来吓唬小孩子的。然而今晚，整片森林正向你娓娓道来——而故事的主角正是你自己。

[摘自[url=https://itzapeggy.itch.io/bestias-v01]itch.io[/url]]
